scope: Research initialization for a copied PR60 2026-08-16 12 UTC WRF input; one 20-second diagnostic run only.

common.center_policy: For each source-active missing moment, select the geometric midpoint of the source-valid slope-parameter interval after intersecting its upper endpoint with the scheme's existing internal number cap. This is a declared research assumption, not an output-fitted value.
common.uncertainty_description: The source-supported slope interval (or graupel bulk-density interval) is a deterministic admissibility envelope, not a statistical sigma or observed uncertainty distribution. The gamma PSD has unbounded individual-diameter support; derived particle-mass limits apply to the mean particle mass implied by the gamma PSD, not to every particle.
common.fill_cutoff_policy: Initialize only when mass is strictly greater than the declared per-species cutoff and the target moment is exactly zero. Strictness is a declared research fill choice; source process branches may use inclusive comparisons or separate number-process thresholds.
common.dry_basis_relation: Internal N = public N * DEN and internal mass = Q * DEN, so source PSD inversion yields public N = Q * lambda^d / pidn; DEN cancels from that ratio. The retained baseline first-call DEN is only a conditional cap proxy; it is not asserted to equal initial wrfinput density and the candidate must be rechecked against its actual first-call trace.
common.changes: Only missing target moments in the WRF active domain are initialized. Existing nonzero moments, all mass mixing ratios, temperature, vapor, CCN, and all other fields remain unchanged. No mass or enthalpy is added; the initialized number/volume moments are research assumptions conditioned on the unchanged masses.

source.model: Selected patched private KDM6 source used by the retained diagnostic build
source.formula_comparison: Checked PSD parameters, lambda bounds, pidn mass-size coefficients, and internal QNICE cap in selected 9f34 source against 02c upstream; these constants/formulas match. Private wrapper public dry-air basis and startup behavior are sourced only from selected private source, not inferred from upstream.
source.kdm6_source_ranges: private wrapper lines 320-327; parameters lines 57-100 and 131-135; PSD inversions lines 1372-1408; pidn formulas lines 3105-3163; graupel density range lines 3283-3310
source.driver_density_binding: module_microphysics_driver.F:2552 passes QMIN=epsilon and DENR=rhowater to KDM6; module_model_constants.F:10 defines epsilon=1e-15
source.instrumented_build_limit: The retained 20-second diagnostic executable reused host objects/libraries; compiler/source closure and operational equivalence are not established.

QCLOUD.center_policy: geometric midpoint of source interval intersected with source NC upper guard

QRAIN.center_policy: geometric midpoint of source interval intersected with source NR upper guard
QRAIN.source_number_process_threshold_note: This threshold is separate from the QRAIN mass cutoff. Report initialized cells whose internal N is below nrmin; do not raise or clip them.

QICE.center_policy: geometric midpoint of per-cell intersection between source interval and source internal ice-number cap
QICE.infeasible_active_cells: Leave unchanged and report if even source lambda_min implies internal NI above 1e6 number m-3; 3,086 such cells in the retained pre-call trace.

QGRAUP.source_lines: ProgB_param defines rho_mid=400 kg m-3 as default density and rho_min/rho_max=[100,900] kg m-3. The separate zero-BG fallback sets rhox=rho_max=900 and is not this prior.
